title: kate-core: keep a slash comment inside a fold
summary: A line whose first text is // is blank for indent folds. A hash comment stays blank. The test goes in the existing fold tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fold.rs is a private module of view.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only the early if in line_indent. Keep let line = line.trim_end_matches('\r'); and let body = line.trim_start_matches([' ', '\t']);. The condition is one if: if body.starts_with('#') || body.starts_with("//") { return LineIndent { blank: true, indent: 0 }; }. Use the array [' ', '\t']. Do not compare a character with a space or a tab by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch indent_folds, fold_at, leading_indent, innermost_fold, or span_contains_line. The existing hash-comment test stays green. The test a_slash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold calls indent_folds of a, newline, two spaces, // note, newline with tab width 4 and gets an empty vector. The same call on a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, // end, newline gets one FoldSpan with start 0 and end 4. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: view::fold::tests::a_slash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A slash comment under a starts a fold. After the change that text has no fold. A slash line at column 0 no longer ends the fold of a and b.
